column3: The Hebrew says “in the ears of the people” and distinguishes each man’s male neighbor and each woman’s female neighbor.
The Hebrew calls Moses “very great” and repeats the image “in the eyes of.”
The Hebrew says “every firstborn,” without explicitly adding “son” to the first expression.
The dog will not “sharpen its tongue,” preserving the image rendered “snarl.”
The people are “at your feet,” preserving the image rendered “who follow you.”
The Hebrew uses a strengthening verb for the heart.
